# Swipe Has Completely Streamlined Alliance Auto Solutions’ Business | A Testimonial by Customer


## About Alliance Auto Solutions


Alliance Auto Solutions is a company in the highly competitive automobile sector in India, dealing in the distribution of spare parts. With voluminous inventories and a complicated sale-purchase cycle, the company was looking for a digitized solution that could be the central point of coordination of the operations, all amid the normal setup mess.


### The Need for a Streamlined System


> Manual billing, manual inventory maintenance, and GST compliance had become too time-consuming and were sporadically interrupted by delays. According to Gaurav Singh, who is in charge of daily operations, in hindsight, the system would have been great if it were simple enough to carve out in days and did not need any intervention from IT professionals.


## Enter Swipe: Fast Setup, Faster Operations


From day one, Swipe delivered:


**1. Quick Onboarding:** Within hours, the team was fully operational and saved crucial time in operational activities.


“The whole setup was very user-friendly. It hardly took a day to configure everything.” He said.


**2. Comprehensive Business Coverage:** Billing, inventory, and monthly GST returns are now completely handled by Swipe, liberating the operation from any other platform or manual reconciliations.


**3. Real-Time Mobile Access:** With mobile-enabled devices, team members can carry out their work anytime, be it on-site, in a warehouse, or at a client site.


“It can be accessed from anywhere, and all transactions can be done from a phone.” He told.


## A True Digital Partner for Inventory, Sales & GST


Here’s how Swipe transformed operations for Alliance Auto Solutions:


1. **Simple Sales and Purchase:** In Swipe, sales and purchase transactions flow from purchase orders to the suppliers and sales invoices to the customers. This way gives them the whole 360-degree view of a certain number of amongst many day-to-day activities they come across.


2. **Inventory Management:** 1000 items are easy to manage, with stock levels continuously updated and stock adjustments almost on autopilot, and visibility available in real-time.


3. **Easy GST Return:** GST returns are monthly, precise, and quick in Swipe.


4. **Real-time Insights and Reporting:** Gaurav reveals the risk he perceived with the detailed reporting features provided by Swipe that gave him a picture of and control over his business opportunities and performance.


"These kinds of reports are tremendous- they show exactly where the business is heading."


5. **Proactive Customer Support:** Continuous focus on user experience, quick resolution, and feedback incorporation from a customer success team are some factors that smooth the usage.


"Their support team is very much proactive—available on WhatsApp and phone."


### Industry Recognition from Peers


According to Gaurav, even customers who have gone out to visit external stakeholders have appreciated how streamlined their operations are and have thus credited Swipe with providing this efficiency.


## Final Words from Gaurav


"Swipe has completely streamlined our business operations. From setup to daily use, it’s been smooth. The design, the features, and the insights—it’s all built to help you grow."


If you are in automotive or any kind of business that deals with inventory, GST, and billing, then Swipe is the game-changer.
